risk_if_not_implemented: Without Digital Media Sanitization Equipment Testing, sensitive and/or regulated data may be retained beyond authorized periods or recovered from improperly disposed media and equipment. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Unauthorized Retention / Inability to Dispose of Data (R-AM-3), Lack of oversight of internal controls (R-GV-6), Loss of Confidentiality (R-IP-2), and most likely increases susceptibility to Human Error (MT-9), Technical / Mechanical Failure (MT-10).

compensating_control_1.name: Digital & Non-Digital Media Disposal
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to securely dispose of, destroy and/or erase digital and non-digital media when it is no longer required, using organization-defined procedures.
compensating_control_1.justification: Digital & Non-Digital Media Disposal (DCH-17) provides physical access control that compensates for the absence of Equipment Testing (DCH-18.3) by preventing unauthorized physical interaction with systems and infrastructure. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Digital Media Sanitization
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to sanitize digital media with the strength and integrity commensurate with the classification or sensitivity of the information prior to disposal, release out of organizational control or release for reuse.
compensating_control_2.justification: Digital Media Sanitization (DCH-18) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of Equipment Testing (DCH-18.3) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism aligned with Technology applicability. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
